independence: Standard-library implementation from protocol/native contract; primary scorer never read, imported or called by this checker

coverage.summary: Every primary summary field, all strata, confusion matrices, timing and provenance compared recursively
coverage.error_records: Exact erroneous ID sets, full input text, gold, predictions and unrounded probabilities; diagnostic issue presence independently checked, wording retained

timing_percentile_definition: P95 uses linear interpolation at index (n-1)*0.95 in sorted valid forward seconds, matching the frozen primary definition; nearest-rank is also retained independently
public_scope: Compact final scientific verification. Canonical source records, independent calculation code and metric summaries remain public.
reproduction_scope: Offline native-record scoring; no model reload, inference or fresh hardware verification.
